_readme: Reference dataset for scripts/import-to-sheet.mjs. Every edge is verified:false and its base is stated in edge_text — these are standard published figures for the base games, NOT transcribed BGC filings, and the California player-banked variants can differ. Side-bet paytables are common schedules; the big top lines (1000:1, 8000:1) are the bank's TAIL EXPOSURE, not prizes. Edit freely in-app after import.

games.name: Ultimate Texas Hold'em
games.edge_text: House edge ~2.185% of Ante (standard rules). Realized banker edge in the CA player-banked form depends on collection + player leak, which is large in UTH — VERIFY
games.rules: Ante + Blind + Play + optional Trips. Player raises 4x pre-flop, 2x on the flop, or 1x on the turn, else folds. Blind pays on a straight or better. Player-dealer banks all wagers.
games.settlement_order: Ante / Blind / Play settle first; Trips and any progressive settle last.
games.notes: Standard published figure; the CA player-banked variant and its collection are not transcribed here. UTH is a high-leak decision game (CLAUDE.md: leak can exceed the structural edge) — realized edge is empirical, not this number.

games.name: Three Card Poker
games.edge_text: Ante+Play house edge ~3.37% of Ante (dealer qualifies Q-high, standard Ante Bonus). Base is the ANTE, not TTA — VERIFY
games.rules: Ante, then see 3 cards and either bet Play = Ante or fold. Dealer qualifies with Queen-high. Ante Bonus pays regardless of dealer: Straight 1:1, Trips 4:1, Straight flush 5:1. Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Ante / Play settle first; Pair Plus, then 6 Card Bonus, settle last.
games.notes: Exposure multiple is an estimate. The tail lives in the side bets (6 Card Bonus tops at 1000:1) — those are bank exposure, not the base game.

games.name: Two Way Winner
games.edge_text: Unsolved — no closed form. Route election (player picks which game their two cards play as) widens edge dispersion; realized edge is leak-driven and empirical.
games.rules: Player's two cards may be elected to play as one of two games (route election), a free option held by the player. Player-dealer banks. Mechanics per the GEGA-004043 filing.
games.settlement_order: Base wager settles first; any bonus settles last.
games.notes: CLAUDE.md flags Two Way Winner as entirely unsolved. Included for reference only — the 0% edge is a placeholder for 'unknown', not a derived value. No side bets sourced; add them here once filed.

games.name: Pai Gow Poker
games.edge_text: Banker edge ~1.27% of base when banking (banker wins copies; 5% commission on net wins). CA collection replaces commission and differs — VERIFY
games.rules: Seven cards set into a 5-card high hand and a 2-card low hand; both must beat the banker's to win. Banker wins copies. Joker is semi-wild (ace, or completes a straight/flush). Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Base settles first; Fortune / progressive side bets settle last.
games.notes: Base is near-even money, so exposure_mult ~1.0 — but the Fortune Bonus tops at 8000:1, which is the real bank tail exposure. Standard figure; CA collection structure not transcribed.

games.name: 21st Century Baccarat
games.edge_text: ~1.123% of TTA when balanced (banker +1.235% vs Player action, +1.011% vs Banker action)
games.rules: 8-deck. CA player-banked variant: a Banker three-card 7 pushes one betting line and wins against the other, and roughly 2.2% of hands carry the entire edge. Player-dealer banks.
games.settlement_order: Player / Banker / Tie base settle first; Dragon Bonus, Dragon 7 / Panda 8, then Pairs settle last.
games.notes: Base edge follows the closed-form baccarat math in CLAUDE.md and is solved for balanced action, but this listing stays unverified: the fee schedule isn't transcribed and the gross-vs-net coverage rule (open question 1) is unconfirmed. Side-bet paytables below are standard published schedules, not filed.

sidebets.name: Trips (Bonus)
sidebets.note: Pays on the player's final 5-card hand regardless of the dealer, so the bank pays it even on a losing hand. Common schedule shown; house edge ~1.9–3.5% depending on the flush/straight lines — VERIFY.

sidebets.name: Progressive / Bad Beat
sidebets.note: Optional $1 progressive; paytable and jackpot seed are room-specific and not sourced. Placeholder — the bank's exposure on the top line can be enormous; capture the real schedule before banking it.

sidebets.name: Pair Plus
sidebets.note: Common 40/30/6/3/1 schedule (~2.32% house edge). Other CA schedules pay Flush 4:1 / Straight 6:1 and shift the edge — VERIFY against the table felt.

sidebets.name: Ante Bonus
sidebets.note: Pays on the player's ante regardless of whether the dealer qualifies — bank pays it even when losing the hand. Standard 1:1 / 4:1 / 5:1 shown.

sidebets.name: 6 Card Bonus
sidebets.note: Best 5-card hand from the player's 3 + dealer's 3 cards. The 1000:1 top line is bank tail exposure that can exceed the bankroll on one hand. House edge ~8–14% depending on schedule — VERIFY.

sidebets.name: Fortune Bonus
sidebets.note: Rates the best 7-card hand. The 8000:1 line (natural 7-card straight flush) is the single largest tail in the room — one hit can exceed the bankroll. Usually carries an Envy bonus paid to other players too. Standard schedule; VERIFY.

sidebets.name: Progressive / Emperor's Challenge
sidebets.note: Room-specific progressive; not sourced. Placeholder — capture the schedule and jackpot rules before banking it.

sidebets.name: Dragon Bonus
sidebets.note: Pays on a natural win or a non-natural win by margin. Standard schedule shown; Banker Dragon house edge ~9.4%, Player ~2.7% — VERIFY. The 30:1 line is the bank's exposure.

sidebets.name: Dragon 7 / Panda 8 (EZ)
sidebets.note: Dragon 7 = Banker wins with a three-card 7 (40:1); Panda 8 = Player wins with a three-card 8 (25:1). Present only in EZ-style variants — confirm the game actually spreads these before booking them.

sidebets.name: Pairs (Player / Banker / Perfect)
sidebets.note: Player Pair / Banker Pair 11:1, Either Pair 5:1, Perfect Pair 25:1. Standard schedule; house edges vary by line — VERIFY.
